name: Native word-delete shortcuts stay unbound
instruction: Global keybinding maps do not bind Ctrl+Backspace or Ctrl+Delete so editable fields keep native word-delete behavior.
relevant_when: TypeScript code that defines Hoppscotch global keyboard shortcut maps or registers keyboard shortcuts used across the app.
context: Recent UI review removed Ctrl+Backspace and Ctrl+Delete from baseBindings because they conflicted with native browser word-delete behavior in editable inputs such as URL, headers, and body fields.
scope_reason: The keybinding file contains the shortcut map and enough evidence to see whether these shortcuts are globally bound.

checklist.name: ctrl-backspace-not-bound
checklist.rule: The global shortcut map does not bind Ctrl+Backspace, ctrl-backspace, or equivalent normalized forms to any Hoppscotch action.

checklist.name: ctrl-delete-not-bound
checklist.rule: The global shortcut map does not bind Ctrl+Delete, ctrl-delete, or equivalent normalized forms to any Hoppscotch action.
